name: Capstone Copper Corp.
summary: Capstone Copper Corp. is a copper mining company with operations and exploration in the United States, Chile and Mexico, also prospecting for silver, zinc and other metals. It fully owns the Pinto Valley copper mine in Arizona, the Mantos Blancos copper-silver mine and Santo Domingo copper-iron-gold-cobalt project in Chile, and the Cozamin copper-silver mine in Mexico.
